biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed jobs: you must win each campaign against hundreds of thousands of creators, and the 'from' figures are minimums — actual pay is set per job by the brand, with JoinBrands taking 15-20% off the top.
catches: The $100+/post, $60+/video, $15+/image figures are minimums ('earn from'), not typical or guaranteed pay — brands set the actual payout per job.
JoinBrands takes a platform fee on every creator payment: 20% on the free plan, 15% with Creator Pro ($10/month). Creator Pro's lower fee only pays for itself if you do real volume.
Free-plan creators face withdrawal limits on earnings (Creator Pro removes them).
You may have to purchase the product yourself upfront (reimbursed) or receive it free, depending on the campaign.
Some campaign types require posting to your own TikTok/Instagram/YouTube — your social reach affects which jobs you can win.
No jobs are guaranteed; marketplace is competitive and brand-selected.

steps: Go to the official creator page https://JoinBrands.com/creator/ and click 'Get started - it's free' to create a creator account (you must be 18+ and in the USA, UK, Germany, Australia, or Canada).
Connect your social accounts (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Amazon — a plus for extra earning) and complete your creator profile.
Browse the job marketplace — every job shows the pay, product value, and commission upfront before you apply.
Apply to jobs that fit your content; the brand selects the creator.
If selected, receive or buy (reimbursed) the product and create the content per the brief.
Submit for approval — once approved, the payout is added to your virtual wallet, then transfer to PayPal. Expect 15-20% platform fee deducted.
timing: Payout added to virtual wallet on content approval; transfer to PayPal anytime (free-plan withdrawal limits may apply).
